name: HAT-P-16

quotes.title: HAT-P-16
quotes.card: HAT-P-16 is a F-type main-sequence star about 725 light-years away.
quotes.introduction: The star has a concentration of heavy elements slightly higher than solar abundance, and low starspot activity.
